biggest_catch: Credits are non-cash bill credits only; new customers receive their $50 as $5/month for 10 months, and fixed-rate plans carry a $150 early cancellation fee plus $6.95–$9.95/month service fees — compare total cost before switching.
catches: $50 reward is a bill credit, not cash — nontransferable, cannot be combined with other offers.
New customers' $50 arrives as $5 in bill credits per month for 10 months (not a lump sum).
Current promotional offer window: 9/6/26–10/5/26; amount may change after that.
Online enrollment only; call-center signups do not qualify.
A $6.95 or $9.95 monthly customer service fee applies ($4.95 for qualified seniors), based on location and credit score; a credit check is required at signup.

Fixed rate plans are subject to a $150 early contract cancellation fee if terminated early; rates plus taxes and Atlanta Gas Light charges still apply (6-month fixed 71¢/therm; 12-month fixed 69¢/therm).
Georgia customers only (Atlanta Gas Light service territory); referred friend must not already be a Gas South customer.

steps: Log in to your Gas South online account and sign up for the Refer a Friend program.
Request and copy your unique referral link.
Share the link with friends or family (email or text).
Your friend enrolls as a new Gas South customer online using your link (or promo code FRIEND).
You receive a $50 bill credit each time a referred friend joins; your friend receives $50 in bill credits at $5/month for the first 10 months.
timing: Referrer's $50 bill credit applies when each referral joins; friend's $50 is paid as $5 in bill credits per month for 10 months.
